findings.expected_vs_actual: Expected: the Forward bullet in docs/ui/navigation.md is accurate in every case. Actual: it says Forward steps off 'so Home stays and one Back leaves the app', but after a reload on the Table followed by Resume, Back, Forward, the judge observed 2 Backs to leave: the earlier load's Table entry is not stepped off, so one Back is a no-op. The last bullet of the same section qualifies this ('Back from Home onto one keeps today's behaviour'), so readers can work it out, but the Forward bullet itself is unqualified.
